essence: The thirty-four-syllable form of Tārā is invoked to protect the entire body.
The ten-syllabled root mantra, framed by kūrca, is invoked to protect the upper part.
Proper reception of this mantra enables one to lead death onto the path of death.
The teaching has now been communicated to the beloved as a component of the armor.
The revealed armor is named Trailokyamohana and is embodied as mantra.
